name: avd-deploy-api
description: AVD Deploy hosted API (ADR 0017-0019). Runs on Node 24 with built-in TypeScript type stripping; no build step.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
